# Tag Input

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:wa-tag-input` · Web Awesome · component · Forms · recommendation: supported

## When to use

Form field that collects a list of short values as removable tags, each submitted as its own form value.

**Not when:**

- Do not choose it from catalog presence alone; confirm that its semantic and interaction contract matches the product need.
- Do not use it for search filters; TokenSearchField combines free text with ordered, editable filter tokens.
- Use it only in an application that has adopted the optional Web Awesome integration (registration imports plus @kerfjs/ui/webawesome.css); a Kerf-only application uses a Kerf component or a native element instead.

**Alternatives:**

- [TokenSearchField](./token-search-field.md) (prefer-kerf) — Use TokenSearchField when the tags are search filters rather than submitted form values.

## Imports

- Theme CSS: import `@kerfjs/ui/webawesome.css` once.
- Registration: import `@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/components/tag-input/tag-input.js` once (a side effect).
- Custom element: `<wa-tag-input>`.
- Declared side effects: custom-element-registration.

Typed JSX attributes: [`webawesome-jsx-signatures-v1.md`](../webawesome-jsx-signatures-v1.md) (import `@kerfjs/ui/webawesome` for types only). Use the Web Awesome attribute API; do not reach into its shadow DOM.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Theme it only through `@kerfjs/ui/webawesome.css` and cataloged tokens. Do not restyle its shadow DOM or uncataloged `::part()` targets (`KUI-L011`).
